unsupported_assertion.instructions: Does the plan make a design assertion that nothing in the plan, the issue or the cited code supports?

criteria.true: At least one design claim has no supporting evidence in the given material
criteria.false: Every design claim is supported by the plan, the issue or cited code

adr_claim_unsupported.instructions: Does the plan claim that an ADR or project rule supports a choice, while the quoted or cited text does not say so?

criteria.true: A cited ADR or rule does not support the claim made about it
criteria.false: Every cited ADR or rule supports the claim, or none is cited

ac_without_verification.instructions: Is there an acceptance criterion for which the plan describes no way to verify it?

criteria.true: At least one acceptance criterion has no test or check described
criteria.false: Every acceptance criterion has a described test or check
